interpretations: For each observatory station with at least one telescope, report its name, the average of its telescopes’ non-null `bandusagepct` values, its telescope count, and that count divided by the mean telescope count per eligible station; sort by the ratio descending and return the first 10 stations.
queries:
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  telescope_count,
  telescope_count / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM station_stats) AS count_ratio
FROM station_stats
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
